name: Open Startup List

sources.title: Homepage — directory of 'open startups' that share metrics publicly; contact form doubles as 'Submit your open startup'

conditions: Your product must already operate as an 'open startup': it publicly shares metrics (revenue, users, traffic) — typically via an /open page, Indie Hackers product page, or verified metrics through Stripe / ChartMogul / Simple Analytics / Google Analytics
requirements: The site defines an Open Startup as 'a company that shares its metrics publicly — visitor analytics, marketing experiments, even revenue'
Revenue verification expected via Stripe, Indie Hackers, or ChartMogul; traffic via Simple Analytics or Google Analytics; uptime via Anyuptime; status page via Hosted Status Page
No dedicated submission form exists — 'Submit your open startup' points to the generic contact form (Full Name, Email, Message)
No fee mentioned; advertising slots exist as a separate paid option
preparation: A live public metrics page or Indie Hackers product page showing revenue/users/traffic
Which verifications you already have (Stripe/ChartMogul revenue, GA/Simple Analytics traffic)
Short description of the startup plus links to the public metrics in the contact-form message
workflow: Set up public metrics sharing first (this is the gate — e.g., Indie Hackers verified revenue or an /open page)
Open https://openstartuplist.com/ and scroll to 'Submit your open startup' / Contact Us form
Send name, email, and a message with the startup name, URL, and links to its public metrics
If accepted, the startup is added to the 'Our Heroes' list with a one-line description
watchFor: Site footer says Copyright 2020 — the directory may be dormant; confirm your listing actually goes up before counting it
Many listed startups link out to Indie Hackers interviews rather than to the product itself
Do not submit a non-transparent product — the entire premise is public metrics
There is a paid 'Advertise' pitch in the same contact area; a listing itself is not advertising
countsAsLive: The startup appears as a named card in the 'Our Heroes' section of openstartuplist.com
unknowns: Whether the contact form is still monitored (site content is dated)
Exact review criteria beyond public metrics
Whether new listings still get added
